trigger: Frozen production x86 runner exhausted its 90-second optional-service setup window before Linux reached its guest agent.
behavior: Keep retrying while VM runs; after 90 seconds report unavailability once and back off 5 seconds between bounded RPC attempts. Monotonic time controls delays. Stop interrupts backoff within 250 ms; existing RPC timeouts still bound in-flight calls.

validation.build: dory-hv executable linked in isolated checkout with Xcode 26.6 RC

limitations: Existing adapter/readiness tests are regression coverage, not a delayed-agent integration test.
The live VM uses the previous frozen runner; its continued boot does not validate the changed retry loop.
Installer-first service preparation and reinitialization after machine reset are not changed by this patch.
